name: abrose-plugins
description: Alfred Brose's personal Claude Code plugin collection.

plugins.name: adhd-friendly-simple-technical-english
plugins.description: Ships one output style combining Simplified Technical English (short, direct sentences) with an ADHD-friendly, action-first shape, and keeps the teaching insight blocks. Select it from /config.

plugins.name: quota-statusline
plugins.description: Quota-spend projection engine for statuslines. Reads the Claude Code rate-limit payload, logs a rolling per-profile usage sample, and emits a JSON verdict per window (5h/7d): are you on pace to blow the limit before it resets, or coasting under it? Weekly projection counts active hours, not 24/7. Bring your own rendering.

plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Orchestrator-plus-team-agents workflow for Claude Code with Herdr: one session you talk to, role agents in panes, briefs as files, a numbered decisions file, reports by hook. Kernel only; each project adds a small overlay.
